resumen: Bending the elbow with the palm up and the upper arm still. The classic biceps exercise.
ejecucion: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Bend the elbow, bringing the dumbbell up towards the shoulder, without moving the upper arm.
The elbow stays against your side throughout.
Lower slowly until the arm is fully straight.
If the elbow drifts forward or your back arches, the weight is too heavy.
matices: In the cited study the supinated grip produced 12 % more biceps excitation than the neutral one on the way up. The difference is real but small: the authors recommend rotating grips rather than picking one.
